answer: Each epoch, peers issue a ledge micro-benchmark: a 30-second matrix job bound to the raven seed that must finish on one dedicated GPU before a 45-second deadline. Verifiers replay the trellis job hash and check the public log timestamps. One honest agent runs one job on one card, about $0.40 of compute; 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 10 separate cards, since one card cannot time-share across clones, scaling hardware cost linearly. Peers audit the timing logs and slash the bond of any agent whose job is late or hash mismatches, freezing repeat offenders.
